answer: Proof-of-novel-data-contribution makes each identity earn its keep: an agent must publish useful, verifiably fresh data — a juniper sensor reading, a new market signal — before it can join the trellis of trusted peers. Every contribution is hashed to a vertex in a shared graph, and duplicate-detection bounties pay anyone who catches a copy. A sybil farm cannot fake novelty at scale: each fake must produce genuinely new data or lose its stake to the hunters.
